1) a recommendation system that supports the knowledge acquisition and sharing process can be implemented as an agent-based solution; 2) the system can be specialised to a specific knowledge domain, and; 3) it can be used as a means of community building.

the use of an ontological approach to knowledge representation is an efficient way of building a distributed recommendation system that can help in the early phase peer search and recognition processes in a virtual engineering team environment, where multidimensional teams must be established.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of agents for supporting the knowledge acquisition and sharing process in a distributed engineering community, where multidisciplinarity is a key factor.
the development of a distributed system for the purpose of collecting and sharing knowledge about possible candidates to form a multidisciplinary team.
how to build and share a distributed engineering community in a virtual environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the developed system is a useful tool that can help to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of knowledge management and sharing processes, specially in distributed engineering environments, where multidiscipline teams are required.
this paper describes an innovative solution for the problem of building multidisciplinary teams, specially in the initial phase of peer search.
this system can help the process of building multidisciplinary engineering teams by offering the possibility of exploring the knowledge domains of possible candidates.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the system developed is a recommendation engine that provides the user with a list of possible candidates, based on a set of criteria that can be adjusted according to the user's requirements.
the system is capable of collecting, aggregating and disseminating information about candidates, their expertise and their knowledge domains.
the system provides a way of sharing knowledge in a collaborative engineering environment by using agents to collect and aggregate information from different sources.
The main takeaway from our work is that
an ontology-based recommendation system can be used to support knowledge sharing processes, specially in the case of multidisciplinary engineering teams.

the system is a valuable resource for the process of community formation, and it is able to provide a good level of accuracy and precision in the recommendation process, even when the amount of available information is scarce.
the use of ontologies can be extended to the problem of knowledge acquisition and sharing.
